scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Demon Pungus?
scripts.translation:
[當地村民]
你獵殺夠50只天邪鬼了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放棄

scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet...
scripts.translation:
[當地村民]
嗯，你好像還沒獵殺夠50只...

scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
Remember, I need help hunting Demon Pungus so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
[當地村民]
記住，我需要你幫忙獵殺天邪鬼，去殺夠50只吧。

scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[當地村民]
確定要放棄狩獵嗎？
目前的任務進度都會清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[當地村民]
好吧，改變主意了就回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
Please kill 50 Demon Pungus.
scripts.translation:
[當地村民]
請獵殺50只天邪鬼。

scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
Amazing, you did that with speed.
scripts.translation:
[當地村民]
真厲害，這麼快就完成了！

[Local Villager]
Hey, you there. Yeah you!
Do you think you can help me with something?
scripts.translation:

能幫我個忙嗎？

scripts.text: Sure

scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
I am trying to make my way through but I can't seem to get past these Demon Pungus.
scripts.translation:
[當地村民]
我想從這裡過去，可這些天邪鬼擋著路，怎麼也過不去。

scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
Can you help by collecting ^FF0000Bacillus^000000?
I will reward you for helping clear this out for me.
scripts.translation:
[當地村民]
幫我收集些^FF0000桿菌^000000，好嗎？
幫我清理掉這些傢伙，我會給你報酬。

scripts.text: I have Bacillus
scripts.translation: 我有桿菌

scripts.text: What did you need?
scripts.translation: 你需要什麼

scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
I had my doubts, but you have proven me wrong.
scripts.translation:
[當地村民]
我本來還心存疑慮，看來是我小看你了。

scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
It doesn't look like you have enough.
scripts.translation:
[當地村民]
看來你收集的還不夠。

scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
I need to see that you have gathered ^FF000050 Bacillus^000000, and then I can reward you.
scripts.translation:
[當地村民]
收集齊^FF000050個桿菌^000000，我才能給你獎勵。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
Ah, ok I think you can help me out by hunting some Demon Pungus.
How many would you like to hunt?
scripts.translation:
[當地村民]
好，那就幫我獵殺些天邪鬼吧。
你打算殺多少隻？

scripts.text:

Yeah, sorry I can't talk right now.
scripts.translation:
[當地村民]
唉，抱歉，我現在顧不上說話。

scripts.text:
[Local Villager]
Its amazing, truly it is.
I just wish I could get through this all.
scripts.translation:

真是不可思議，真的。
我只盼著能從這裡過去。
